code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); flat=sum(g,[])
    bg=max(set(flat),key=flat.count)
    divs=[r for r in range(1,h-1) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    blank_row=lambda r: all(v==bg for v in g[r][1:-1])
    if divs:
        d=divs[0]; a=d-1
        b=next(r for r in range(d+1,h) if sum(v!=bg for v in g[r])>=3)
        diffs=[c for c in range(1,w-1) if g[a][c]!=g[b][c] and (g[a][c]!=bg or g[b][c]!=bg)]
        ta=next((r for r in range(a+1,b) if blank_row(r)),a)
        tb=next((r for r in range(b+1,h) if blank_row(r)),b)
        if ta==a:
            for c in diffs: g[a][c]=bg
            if diffs: g[a][0]=grid[a][diffs[0]]
        else:
            for c in range(1,w-1):
                if grid[a][c]==grid[b][c] and grid[a][c]!=bg: g[ta][c]=grid[a][c]
        if tb!=b:
            for c in diffs: g[tb][c]=grid[b][c]
        return g
    # Vertical divider: sequences are arranged in columns.
    d=next(c for c in range(1,w-1) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg)
    a=d-1
    b=next(c for c in range(d+1,w) if sum(g[r][c]!=bg for r in range(h))>=3)
    diffs=[r for r in range(1,h-1) if g[r][a]!=g[r][b] and (g[r][a]!=bg or g[r][b]!=bg)]
    for r in diffs:
        g[r][0]=grid[r][a]; g[r][a]=bg
    return g
'''
